# hibira_account (Resource)

An operator's settings on an existing customer account: its custom (Enterprise) plan, operator note and tags, and Chat API beta. Needs the provider's `console_token` (scopes `accounts:read` and `accounts:write`) and the Cloudflare Access service token.

Terraform doesn't create or delete accounts: creating this resource takes over an account that exists, and destroying it only stops managing it, leaving the account as it is. `note`, `tags` and `chat_beta` are managed only when set. `custom_plan` is always managed: leaving it out means the account has no custom plan.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "hibira_account" "demo" {
  email = "demo@example.com"
}

# A $0 custom plan with one app, tagged as an internal account.
resource "hibira_account" "demo" {
  id   = data.hibira_account.demo.id
  tags = ["internal"]

  custom_plan = {
    max_apps        = 1
    max_connections = 1000
    daily_messages  = 200000
    currency        = "usd"
    note            = "Demo account"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The account ID (`acct_...`). Look one up by email with `data.hibira_account`.

### Optional

- `chat_beta` (Boolean) Whether the account is in the Chat API beta. Managed only when set.
- `custom_plan` (Attributes) Enterprise terms that replace the account's plan limits. Leave it out for none. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--custom_plan))
- `note` (String) The operator note (only operators see it). Managed only when set.
- `tags` (Set of String) The operator tags, such as `internal`. Managed only when set.

### Read-Only

- `effective_plan` (String) The plan whose limits apply (`enterprise` with a custom plan).
- `email` (String) The account's email.
- `name` (String) The account's name.
- `plan` (String) The plan the account pays for.
- `status` (String) The subscription status.

<a id="nestedatt--custom_plan"></a>
### Nested Schema for `custom_plan`

Required:

- `currency` (String) The currency in lower case, such as `usd`.
- `daily_messages` (Number) Messages per day.
- `max_apps` (Number) Apps the account may have.
- `max_connections` (Number) Concurrent connections per app.

Optional:

- `monthly_price` (Number) The price per month in the currency's smallest unit (cents for `usd`). Defaults to 0.
- `note` (String) A note on the terms.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import first to see in a plan what Terraform would change on an account.
terraform import hibira_account.demo acct_123
```
